title: Lopez Research：黄仁勋回归，AI交易逻辑生变？
speaker: Maribel Lopez

segments.en: Actually, there were some positives and then there were some negatives. So if we impact the positives, there was a tremendous drop in India stock.
segments.zh: 其实有积极也有消极的一面。先说积极面，印度市场曾大幅下跌。

segments.en: And that really said that we didn't believe that there was another leader to champion the next wave of AI.
segments.zh: 这确实表明，我们不相信还有另一位领导者能引领下一波AI浪潮。

segments.en: So when we look at that, we can say that bringing back Jensen was what the board and the shareholders wanted.
segments.zh: 所以，让Jensen回归是董事会和股东的意愿。

segments.en: But then after that, I think we're looking at the fundamentals of the AI trade in general and there's still always been this concept of what's the gap between what we're spending and what's the revenue that we're giving.
segments.zh: 但之后，我认为我们要看AI交易的基本面，始终存在支出与收入之间差距的问题。

segments.en: And I think you know, nothing was better than that than the anthropic IPO.
segments.zh: 我认为，没有比Anthropic的IPO更能体现这一点的了。

segments.en: You know, tremendous enthusiasm. How do we get into the AI wave?
segments.zh: 热情高涨，大家都在想如何加入AI浪潮。

segments.en: Lot of real estate, you know, not fundamental investors, but just a broad spectrum of investors interested in that.
segments.zh: 很多地产领域的市场参与者，并非基本面市场参与者，而是广泛市场参与者都对此感兴趣。

segments.en: And now they're all like, oh, wait, are the models actually gonna make any money?
segments.zh: 现在他们都在想，等等，这些模型真的能赚钱吗？

segments.en: So I think where we've seen a lot of hesitation and a lot of discussion about how do we actually think about the AI trade going forward
segments.zh: 所以，我们看到很多犹豫和讨论，关于未来几年如何思考AI交易。

segments.en: over the next couple of years? Everybody thinks the picks and shovels like the chip to the way to go.
segments.zh: 未来几年，大家都认为芯片等基础领域是方向。

segments.en: We could argue if picks and shovels are chips anymore because there's so much that's wrapped around in video in terms of software and physical AI and the next generation of technology
segments.zh: 我们或许可以争论芯片是否还是核心基础，因为软件、实体AI和下一代技术已经赋予其太多内涵，它们不再只是简单的组件公司。

segments.en: that they're not just a simple component company. And I think that is really one of the reasons why there was so much hesitation over changing management.
segments.zh: 我认为这正是管理层变动犹豫不决的原因之一。
